words.enDefinition: money paid to reserve a place before signing

examples.en: Before I send the holding deposit, could you confirm how long you'll hold the room?
examples.zh: 我付「预留押金」以前，能确认一下你们会给我留房多久吗？

examples.en: The agent deducted the holding deposit from the amount we owed when we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们入住时，中介从应付款中扣除了已交的「预留押金」。

words.enDefinition: UK term for money held as security under a tenancy

examples.en: I paid the tenancy deposit after signing and saved the transfer confirmation for my records.
examples.zh: 我签约后交了「租赁押金」，留存了转账凭证。

examples.en: Could you confirm where the tenancy deposit is held while we are living here?
examples.zh: 请问我们住在这里期间，「租赁押金」存放在哪里？

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount that can be required upfront as security

examples.en: We asked the housing office whether the deposit cap applies to our furnished student flat.
examples.zh: 我们问了学校住房办公室，这套带家具的学生公寓是否也受「押金上限」约束。

examples.en: The agent reduced the amount after we pointed out the deposit cap for this property.
examples.zh: 我们指出这套房适用的「押金上限」后，中介调低了金额。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that safeguards tenants' deposits and helps resolve disputes

examples.en: Our landlord emailed the name of the deposit protection scheme and explained how to check registration.
examples.zh: 房东发邮件告知了「押金保障计划」的名称，还说明怎么查登记。

examples.en: I contacted the deposit protection scheme after the agent stopped answering questions about our deposit.
examples.zh: 中介不再回答押金问题后，我联系了「押金保障计划」的运营方。

collocations: register with a deposit protection scheme

words.enDefinition: a plan in which the provider holds tenants' deposits in its own account

examples.en: Under the custodial scheme, the scheme provider holds the money until we move out.
examples.zh: 采用「托管式押金保障」后，押金由计划运营方保管到我们退租。

examples.en: The agent prefers a custodial scheme because the office never has to hold our money.
examples.zh: 中介更倾向用「托管式押金保障」，因为他们办公室不用经手我们的钱。

words.enDefinition: a plan backed by insurance where landlords keep deposit money

examples.en: The landlord uses an insured scheme, so she keeps the deposit during our tenancy.
examples.zh: 房东采用「保险式押金保障」，所以租期内由她保管押金。

examples.en: We checked the paperwork because an insured scheme had replaced the previous arrangement this year.
examples.zh: 今年改用「保险式押金保障」后，我们核对了相关文件。

words.enDefinition: the submission of rental security money to a designated authority

examples.en: The agent sent confirmation of bond lodgement after the money reached the bond authority.
examples.zh: 保证金到账后，中介发来了「租房保证金登记」的确认凭证。

examples.en: Our Australian housing adviser asked to see the bond lodgement form before contacting the agent.
examples.zh: 我们在澳大利亚的住房顾问想先看「租房保证金登记」表，再与中介联系。

words.enDefinition: Australian and New Zealand term for money paid as rental security

examples.en: My new roommate and I paid the rental bond before collecting the keys in Melbourne.
examples.zh: 我和新室友在墨尔本拿钥匙前交了「租房保证金」。

examples.en: After we returned the keys, the agent explained how to reclaim the rental bond online.
examples.zh: 还钥匙后，中介讲了怎么在网上申请退还「租房保证金」。

words.enDefinition: the reference identifying a registered rental security payment

examples.en: The online refund form asks for the bond number on our original registration email.
examples.zh: 网上退款表需要填最初登记邮件里的「保证金登记编号」。

examples.en: I saved our bond number with the lease so either roommate could find it.
examples.zh: 我把「保证金登记编号」和租约放在一起，这样两个室友都能找到。

words.enDefinition: a request for payment from a registered rental bond

examples.en: The agent submitted a bond claim for the broken cupboard door after our tenancy ended.
examples.zh: 租期结束后，中介就损坏的柜门提交了「保证金申领」。

examples.en: We received an email about a bond claim and logged in to check the amount.
examples.zh: 我们收到一封关于「保证金申领」的邮件，就登录查看了金额。

words.enDefinition: money returned from a rental bond after a tenancy ends

examples.en: My bond refund arrived two days after the property manager approved the amount online.
examples.zh: 物业经理在网上确认金额后两天，我收到了「保证金退款」。

examples.en: Please check that the bond refund will go to both roommates in the agreed shares.
examples.zh: 请确认「保证金退款」会按约定比例分别退给两位室友。

words.enDefinition: a charge for handling paperwork and managing a request

examples.en: I asked what the administration fee covered before agreeing to the other move-in charges.
examples.zh: 我先问清「行政手续费」涵盖哪些事项，再同意其他入住费用。

examples.en: There was no administration fee listed on the estimate the housing office gave us.
examples.zh: 住房办公室给我们的费用估算表上没有列「行政手续费」。

words.enDefinition: money charged for assessing a prospective renter's suitability

examples.en: We asked whether each roommate had to pay a separate screening fee with the application.
examples.zh: 我们询问合租申请时，是不是每位室友都得单独交一份「租客审核费」。

examples.en: My screening fee covered the checks, but it wasn't enough to reserve the room.
examples.zh: 我交的「租客审核费」只用于审核，并不能保留房间。

words.enDefinition: a charge for checking someone's record of borrowing and repayment

examples.en: The leasing office explained the credit check fee before asking for permission to check my history.
examples.zh: 租赁办公室先说明了「信用核查费」，才请我授权查询信用记录。

examples.en: The manager waived the credit check fee after I supplied a recent report from my bank.
examples.zh: 我给物业经理看了一份近期的银行报告，之后对方免了「信用核查费」。

words.enDefinition: money held against damage that a renter's animal might cause

examples.en: Our landlord asked for a pet deposit before letting my roommate bring her cat upstairs.
examples.zh: 房东要求室友先交「宠物押金」，才允许她把猫带上楼。

examples.en: We got our pet deposit back after the manager checked the carpet for damage.
examples.zh: 物业经理确认地毯没有损坏后，我们拿回了「宠物押金」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for allowing a renter to keep an animal

examples.en: The listing showed a one-time pet fee, which we included when comparing the two flats.
examples.zh: 房源信息列了一笔一次性的「宠物费」，我们比较两套房时也把它算进去了。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the pet fee was charged per animal or per apartment.
examples.zh: 我室友问「宠物费」是按宠物数量收，还是按每套公寓收。

words.enDefinition: money held until an electronic access device is returned

examples.en: The housing office kept my fob deposit until I handed back the electronic key.
examples.zh: 我把电子钥匙交回住房办公室后，才拿回「门禁感应钥匙押金」。

examples.en: We paid one fob deposit for each of the two access devices issued to us.
examples.zh: 我们领了两把门禁感应钥匙，每把都交了一份「门禁感应钥匙押金」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement letting tenants rent without a conventional cash deposit

examples.en: The building offered a security deposit waiver for a fee, but I chose to pay the deposit.
examples.zh: 这栋楼提供付费的「租房押金免缴方案」，但我还是选择直接交押金。

examples.en: I asked whether the security deposit waiver changed what we would owe for damage when leaving.
examples.zh: 我问选了「租房押金免缴方案」以后，退租时损坏物品的赔偿责任会不会变。

words.enDefinition: a third party's promise to cover a potential claim

examples.en: My university offered a deposit guarantee that the landlord could accept instead of upfront cash.
examples.zh: 学校提供了一种「租房押金担保」，房东可以用它代替先收现金。

examples.en: The landlord liked the deposit guarantee but asked who would handle a claim about damage.
examples.zh: 房东觉得「租房押金担保」不错，但想知道房屋受损时由谁处理索赔。

words.enDefinition: a charge collected when a tenant first occupies a home

examples.en: I found a move-in fee in the cost breakdown that wasn't mentioned in the listing.
examples.zh: 我在费用明细里发现一笔房源信息没提到的「入住手续费」。

examples.en: The manager said the move-in fee covered booking the lift and registering our access cards.
examples.zh: 物业经理说「入住手续费」包含预约电梯和登记门禁卡。

words.enDefinition: a charge collected when a tenant vacates a property

examples.en: The agent mentioned a move-out fee when we arranged to hand back the keys.
examples.zh: 我们约时间还钥匙时，中介提到了一笔「退租手续费」。

examples.en: Before paying the move-out fee, I asked the manager to explain what it covered.
examples.zh: 交「退租手续费」之前，我请物业经理说明这笔钱都用于什么。

words.enDefinition: a charge for letting a locked-out occupant back inside

examples.en: My landlord warned me about the lockout fee before coming over to let me inside.
examples.zh: 房东来给我开门之前，先告诉我需要付「开门服务费」。

examples.en: The residence charges a lockout fee after hours, so I left a spare key with my roommate.
examples.zh: 宿舍下班后帮忙开门要收「开门服务费」，所以我把一把备用钥匙交给了室友。

words.enDefinition: money charged for issuing a substitute for a missing key

examples.en: I paid the key replacement fee because one of the apartment keys disappeared during our move.
examples.zh: 搬家时有一把公寓钥匙找不到了，我交了「补配钥匙费」。

examples.en: The office reversed the key replacement fee after I found the key and handed it in.
examples.zh: 我找到钥匙并交回去后，办公室撤销了「补配钥匙费」。

words.enDefinition: money held against the cost of leaving a property dirty

examples.en: The manager returned our cleaning deposit once she saw that we'd cleaned the oven and fridge.
examples.zh: 物业经理看到烤箱和冰箱都已清理，就退还了「清洁押金」。

examples.en: The fee table listed a separate cleaning deposit and explained when it would be returned.
examples.zh: 收费表单独列出了「清洁押金」，还说明了什么时候会退。

words.enDefinition: money charged for cleaning a place after someone leaves

examples.en: We disputed the cleaning fee because our photographs showed the kitchen was already clean.
examples.zh: 我们对「清洁费」提出了异议，因为照片显示厨房当时已经干净。

examples.en: The listing mentioned a cleaning fee, so we asked whether cleaning the room ourselves was an option.
examples.zh: 房源信息写着要收「清洁费」，于是我们问能不能自己打扫房间。

words.enDefinition: an agreement limiting what someone pays for certain damage

examples.en: I read the damage waiver carefully because it covered only a few types of accidental damage.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「损坏赔偿豁免」，因为它只涵盖几种意外损坏。

examples.en: The damage waiver excluded missing furniture, so we checked every item before moving out.
examples.zh: 「损坏赔偿豁免」不涵盖家具丢失，所以搬走前我们逐件核对了家具。

collocations: the scope of a damage waiver

words.enDefinition: money billed for harm to rented property or furnishings

examples.en: The damage charge was for a cracked shelf that we'd photographed on our first day.
examples.zh: 这笔「损坏赔偿费」针对的是一块裂开的搁板，我们入住第一天就拍过照。

examples.en: The landlord removed the damage charge when the worker confirmed that the damage was already there.
examples.zh: 维修人员证实损坏早就存在，房东取消了「损坏赔偿费」。

words.enDefinition: money charged for collecting waste left at a property

examples.en: We asked about the rubbish removal charge because the bin bags belonged to a different flat.
examples.zh: 我们询问了「垃圾清运费」，因为那几袋垃圾是另一套公寓住户的。

examples.en: The agent removed the rubbish removal charge after we sent a photo of the empty yard.
examples.zh: 我们发去院子已经清空的照片后，中介取消了「垃圾清运费」。

collocations: a rubbish removal charge on the statement

words.enDefinition: a charge for finding a replacement renter before a tenancy ends

examples.en: The agent quoted a reletting fee after our exchange programme ended earlier than we had expected.
examples.zh: 我们的交换项目比预期结束得早，中介随后给出了「重新招租费」的报价。

examples.en: We asked whether the reletting fee would still apply if we found a replacement ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们问，如果自己找到接手租房的人，还要不要交「重新招租费」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for transferring an existing lease to another person

examples.en: The manager quoted a lease assignment fee when another student agreed to take over my tenancy.
examples.zh: 另一名学生同意接手我的租约时，物业经理给出了「租约转让手续费」的报价。

examples.en: We asked who was responsible for the lease assignment fee before sending in the paperwork.
examples.zh: 提交材料前，我们问清了「租约转让手续费」由谁来付。

words.enDefinition: money charged for booking exclusive elevator use during a move

examples.en: An elevator reservation fee appeared on our bill because we booked the service elevator for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们预约了周六用货梯，所以账单上多了一笔「电梯预约费」。

examples.en: I asked about the elevator reservation fee before confirming the delivery date for my new desk.
examples.zh: 确定新书桌的送货日期前，我先问了「电梯预约费」。

words.enDefinition: unable to be returned after the payment is made

examples.en: The application payment is non-refundable, so I asked to see the room before applying.
examples.zh: 申请时交的钱「不可退还」，所以我提出先看房再申请。

examples.en: We checked which charges were non-refundable before deciding to reserve the larger room.
examples.zh: 决定预留大一点的房间前，我们问清了哪些费用「不可退还」。

words.enDefinition: the return of all the money that was paid

examples.en: The agent issued a full refund because the advertised room was no longer available.
examples.zh: 中介发现广告里的房间已经租出去了，就给了我们「全额退款」。

examples.en: I expected a full refund because we had left the flat in good condition.
examples.zh: 我原本以为会收到「全额退款」，因为我们退租时房况很好。

words.enDefinition: the return of less than the entire amount paid

examples.en: We accepted a partial refund after the landlord showed us the receipt for the broken lamp.
examples.zh: 房东出示了更换损坏台灯的收据，我们接受了「部分退款」。

examples.en: I received a partial refund and asked for a list of what had been deducted.
examples.zh: 我收到了「部分退款」，并要求提供扣款明细。

words.enDefinition: the last date by which money should be returned

examples.en: We noted the refund deadline in our calendar before returning the keys on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五还钥匙之前，把「退款截止日期」记在了日历上。

examples.en: After the refund deadline passed, I emailed the manager with a copy of our handover form.
examples.zh: 「退款截止日期」过后，我给物业经理发了邮件，附上交接表的副本。

words.enDefinition: give back security money previously paid by a renter

examples.en: The landlord promised to return the deposit once we gave her our new bank details.
examples.zh: 房东答应，在我们提供新的银行账户信息后就「退还押金」。

examples.en: Could you return the deposit to the same account we used for the original payment?
examples.zh: 可以把「退还押金」的钱打到我们当时付款用的账户吗？

words.enDefinition: receive rental security money paid earlier

examples.en: We wanted to get the deposit back, so both roommates stayed to finish cleaning the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们想「拿回押金」，所以两个室友都留下来把厨房打扫完了。

examples.en: How long does it usually take to get the deposit back after handing over the keys?
examples.zh: 交还钥匙后，一般多久能「拿回押金」？

collocations: hope to get the deposit back
get the deposit back in full

words.enDefinition: a formal or informal request to have money returned

examples.en: My refund request included the checkout date and a copy of the original fee receipt.
examples.zh: 我的「退款申请」中附上了退租日期和原始费用收据的副本。

examples.en: I asked the letting agency whether it had received my refund request before the holidays.
examples.zh: 我问中介公司，放假前有没有收到我的「退款申请」。

words.enDefinition: the new address used to send mail after a move

examples.en: I gave the landlord my forwarding address so the final cheque wouldn't go to the old flat.
examples.zh: 我把「邮件转寄地址」给了房东，免得最后的退款支票寄到旧公寓。

examples.en: Can I leave my parents' home as a forwarding address until I find another rental?
examples.zh: 在找到下一套出租房之前，我能先把父母家留作「邮件转寄地址」吗？

collocations: mail a refund to a forwarding address

words.expression: refund to the original payment method
words.lemma: refund to the original payment method
words.enDefinition: return money through the same channel used to pay
acceptedEnVariants: refund to the original payment method

examples.en: The agency can refund to the original payment method if my card account is still open.
examples.zh: 如果我的银行卡账户仍在使用，中介就可以「原路退款」。

examples.en: Can you refund to the original payment method, or do you need my new bank details?
examples.zh: 你们可以「原路退款」，还是需要我提供新的银行账户信息才能退款？

collocations: request a refund to the original payment method
automatically refund to the original payment method
agree to refund to the original payment method

words.enDefinition: a written payment order that has not been deposited or redeemed

examples.en: The agency traced an uncashed check that had been sent to my old address.
examples.zh: 中介查到一张寄往我旧住址的「未兑付支票」。

examples.en: The housing office agreed to cancel the uncashed check and send the money by bank transfer.
examples.zh: 住房办公室同意作废那张「未兑付支票」，改用银行转账退款。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that rental security money was received

examples.en: I asked the agent to send a deposit receipt showing the amount paid by each roommate.
examples.zh: 我请中介开一份「押金收据」，写明每位室友分别交了多少。

examples.en: The manager couldn't find our payment until I showed her the deposit receipt from August.
examples.zh: 我把八月份的「押金收据」给物业经理看，她才找到那笔付款。

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a specific payment

examples.en: I sent the transaction reference so the landlord could match the payment to our flat.
examples.zh: 我发了「交易参考号」，方便房东确认这笔钱是我们这套公寓交的。

examples.en: The bank asked for the transaction reference when I called to trace the missing refund.
examples.zh: 我打电话追查一笔没到账的退款时，银行要我提供「交易参考号」。

words.enDefinition: a signed or recorded statement confirming receipt of something

examples.en: We requested written acknowledgment that the landlord had received both the keys and the parking pass.
examples.zh: 我们要求房东给一份「书面签收确认」，证明钥匙和停车证均已收到。

examples.en: The office sent written acknowledgment after we dropped off the cleaning receipts and photographs.
examples.zh: 我们把清洁收据和照片交过去后，办公室给了「书面签收确认」。

words.enDefinition: keep money with a neutral party pending agreed conditions

examples.en: The agent volunteered to hold funds in escrow until both sides agreed what the tenant owed.
examples.zh: 中介主动提出先「托管款项」，等双方就租客应付金额达成一致再处理。

examples.en: We asked whether a neutral third party could hold funds in escrow while the claim was reviewed.
examples.zh: 我们问，审核索赔期间能否由中立第三方「托管款项」。

collocations: hold funds in escrow until settlement
agree to hold funds in escrow
hold funds in escrow pending approval

words.enDefinition: an account holding funds until specified conditions are met

examples.en: Our agent uses an escrow account to keep tenants' deposits separate from ordinary rent payments.
examples.zh: 中介用「第三方托管账户」保管租客押金，让押金和日常租金分开。

examples.en: I asked which conditions would trigger a payment out of the escrow account after moving.
examples.zh: 我问，搬走后在什么条件下可以从「第三方托管账户」放款。

collocations: deposit money into an escrow account
release money from an escrow account

words.enDefinition: an account holding money on behalf of other people

examples.en: The notice said that the letting agency kept client funds in a separate trust account.
examples.zh: 告示写着，中介公司把客户资金单独存在一个「信托账户」里。

examples.en: We asked for a statement showing when our money entered the agent's trust account.
examples.zh: 我们要求提供一份账单，显示我们的钱是什么时候转入中介的「信托账户」的。

words.enDefinition: interest earned over time but not yet paid

examples.en: The final statement showed the deposit amount and any accrued interest separately on two lines.
examples.zh: 最终账单分两行列出了押金金额和「累计利息」。

examples.en: I asked why the refund didn't include the accrued interest listed on the previous year's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这次退款为什么没包含去年账单上列的「累计利息」。

words.enDefinition: an account that earns interest on money kept in it

examples.en: Our landlord put the deposit in an interest-bearing account and sent us the bank confirmation.
examples.zh: 房东把押金存进了「计息账户」，还发来了银行的确认凭证。

examples.en: I asked whether the interest-bearing account provided an annual statement we could keep for our records.
examples.zh: 我问这个「计息账户」是否提供年度账单，以便我们留存。

collocations: deposit funds in an interest-bearing account

words.enDefinition: authorize held security money to be paid out

examples.en: Both parties signed the form to release the deposit once the final deductions were agreed.
examples.zh: 就最终扣款达成一致后，双方签了用于「解付押金」的表格。

examples.en: The scheme cannot release the deposit while our disagreement about the missing key is still open.
examples.zh: 关于遗失钥匙的争议还没解决，押金保障计划运营方暂时无法「解付押金」。

collocations: authorize an agent to release the deposit

words.enDefinition: keep security money instead of returning it when requested

examples.en: The landlord threatened to withhold the deposit unless we replaced the damaged sofa before leaving.
examples.zh: 房东说，如果我们搬走前不换掉损坏的沙发，就要「扣留押金」。

examples.en: We asked whether the manager had a reason to withhold the deposit after we'd settled both charges.
examples.zh: 两笔费用都结清后，我们问物业经理还有什么理由「扣留押金」。

words.enDefinition: lose the right to recover previously paid security money

examples.en: My roommate feared we'd forfeit the deposit if we cancelled the reservation before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 我室友担心，签租约前取消预留，我们就会「失去押金」。

examples.en: Before withdrawing my application, I asked whether I would have to forfeit the deposit.
examples.zh: 撤回申请前，我问这样做会不会让我「失去押金」。

collocations: risk having to forfeit the deposit

words.enDefinition: use the money held as security to cover a charge

examples.en: We agreed to apply the deposit to the repair costs and ask for the remainder back.
examples.zh: 我们同意「用押金抵扣」维修费用，再要求退回余额。

examples.en: The agent wanted to apply the deposit against the final charge for replacing a damaged desk.
examples.zh: 中介想「用押金抵扣」更换受损书桌的最后一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: subtract a charge from money held as security

examples.en: These are the only costs the manager says she can deduct from the deposit this month.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，她这个月只会把这几笔费用「从押金扣除」。

examples.en: Please show me each repair cost you intend to deduct from the deposit before issuing the refund.
examples.zh: 退款之前，请列明每笔打算「从押金扣除」的维修费用。

collocations: an amount to deduct from the deposit
the right to deduct from the deposit
claim an amount to deduct from the deposit

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted from a tenant's security money

examples.en: The only deposit deduction we accepted was the cost of replacing the missing house key.
examples.zh: 我们只同意一笔「押金扣款」，用于补配丢失的房门钥匙。

examples.en: I asked the agency to justify the deposit deduction for the mark on the counter.
examples.zh: 我请中介说明，台面上的痕迹为什么会产生这笔「押金扣款」。

words.enDefinition: a document listing individual amounts and what each covers

examples.en: We requested an itemized statement because the email gave only a single total for cleaning.
examples.zh: 邮件只给出了清洁费用总额，所以我们要求提供「逐项明细账单」。

examples.en: The itemized statement showed separate amounts for the replacement key and the missing parking pass.
examples.zh: 「逐项明细账单」分别列出了补配钥匙和补办遗失停车证的金额。

words.enDefinition: an examination of harm and its likely repair cost

examples.en: The manager completed a damage assessment before deciding how much to deduct from the deposit.
examples.zh: 物业经理先做了「损坏评估」，再决定要从押金里扣多少。

examples.en: We asked to see the damage assessment because the work appeared more extensive than necessary.
examples.zh: 维修范围看起来超出了实际需要，所以我们要求查看「损坏评估」。

words.enDefinition: an amount that is fair given the circumstances involved

examples.en: We agreed to pay the reasonable cost of repairing the hinge after reviewing two quotes.
examples.zh: 看了两份报价后，我们同意支付修理铰链的「合理费用」。

examples.en: The adviser asked what a reasonable cost would be for a panel of that size.
examples.zh: 顾问问，更换那种尺寸的面板要多少钱才算「合理费用」。

words.enDefinition: a price offered by a contractor for a specified repair

examples.en: The landlord sent a repair quote before asking us to agree to any deductions.
examples.zh: 房东先发了「维修报价」，才请我们同意扣款。

examples.en: I asked a local carpenter for a repair quote to check whether the charge was fair.
examples.zh: 我找当地木工要了一份「维修报价」，想看看这笔收费是否合理。

collocations: compare a repair quote with the invoice

words.enDefinition: the expense of obtaining a substitute for a damaged item

examples.en: The agent asked us to cover the replacement cost of two missing kitchen stools.
examples.zh: 中介让我们承担丢失的两把厨房高脚凳的「更换成本」。

examples.en: The replacement cost seemed high, so I checked the price of the same model online.
examples.zh: 「更换成本」看起来偏高，我就上网查了同一型号的价格。

words.enDefinition: the amount billed for a worker's time on a job

examples.en: The invoice listed a labor charge but didn't say how long the worker had been there.
examples.zh: 发票列了「人工费」，但没有说明工人在那里干了多久。

examples.en: We agreed to the labor charge after the repair company explained its minimum call-out time.
examples.zh: 维修公司说明最低上门计时后，我们同意支付这笔「人工费」。

words.enDefinition: the amount spent on items needed to do work

examples.en: The materials cost was low because the carpenter only needed screws and a small bracket.
examples.zh: 木工只用了螺丝和一个小支架，所以「材料成本」不高。

examples.en: The invoice showed a materials cost that was much higher than we expected for one shelf.
examples.zh: 发票上列的「材料成本」远高于我们对一块搁板的预估。

words.enDefinition: a document requesting payment for cleaning services already performed

examples.en: Could you forward the cleaning invoice so we can see which rooms the company cleaned?
examples.zh: 能转发一下「清洁服务账单」吗？我们想看看清洁公司打扫了哪些房间。

examples.en: The cleaning invoice showed a two-hour visit, which matched the deduction on our final statement.
examples.zh: 「清洁服务账单」上写的是两小时，和最终账单上的扣款相符。

collocations: request a copy of the cleaning invoice

words.enDefinition: the first version of a bill issued by its supplier

examples.en: The agent revised the charge after I compared the amount with the original invoice.
examples.zh: 我把扣款金额与「原始发票」核对后，中介修改了收费。

examples.en: We asked for the original invoice because the statement only listed a rounded amount.
examples.zh: 账单上只列了一个凑整的金额，所以我们索要了「原始发票」。

words.enDefinition: the period an item can still reasonably be used

examples.en: We asked whether the remaining useful life of the old rug affected what we would owe.
examples.zh: 我们问，旧地毯的「剩余使用年限」是否会影响需要赔偿的金额。

examples.en: The adviser used the remaining useful life of our kitchen appliance to estimate a fair deduction.
examples.zh: 顾问参考我们那件厨房电器的「剩余使用年限」，估算了合理的扣款金额。

words.enDefinition: the worth of an item after allowing for age and use

examples.en: We offered to pay the depreciated value of the worn desk rather than its original price.
examples.zh: 我们提出按这张旧书桌的「折旧后价值」赔偿，而不按它的原价赔。

examples.en: The final statement used the depreciated value of the broken appliance to calculate what we owed.
examples.zh: 最终账单按照损坏电器的「折旧后价值」计算了我们应付的金额。

words.enDefinition: substituting an item with another of comparable kind and quality

examples.en: The manager requested a like-for-like replacement after one of the dining chairs broke during our tenancy.
examples.zh: 租期内一把餐椅坏了，物业经理要求做「同等规格更换」。

examples.en: We found a like-for-like replacement online that cost less than the chair quoted by the agent.
examples.zh: 我们在网上找到了可用于「同等规格更换」的椅子，比中介报价里的椅子便宜。

collocations: the cost of a like-for-like replacement

words.enDefinition: an improvement beyond the property's condition before the damage

examples.en: The adviser raised betterment when the landlord tried to replace our old carpet with hardwood.
examples.zh: 房东打算把旧地毯换成实木地板时，顾问提到了这种「超出原状的增益」。

examples.en: We questioned the charge for betterment because the new countertop was a substantial upgrade.
examples.zh: 我们对「超出原状的增益」这部分费用提出疑问，因为新台面比原来的好很多。

words.enDefinition: a mark that was present before the tenant moved in

examples.en: I showed the agent a photo of the pre-existing stain on the bedroom carpet.
examples.zh: 我给中介看了卧室地毯上「入住前已有的污渍」的照片。

examples.en: The review found that the landlord had charged us for a pre-existing stain near the door.
examples.zh: 复核发现，房东把门边「入住前已有的污渍」算成了我们的费用。

words.enDefinition: harm caused unintentionally to property or belongings

examples.en: Our roommate reported accidental damage after dropping a heavy pan on the glass cooktop.
examples.zh: 室友把一只重锅掉在玻璃灶面上，事后报告了这次「意外损坏」。

examples.en: I checked whether the optional policy covered accidental damage to furniture supplied with the flat.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，那份可选保单是否涵盖公寓配套家具的「意外损坏」。

words.enDefinition: harm to the property resulting from a renter's actions

examples.en: The agency distinguished tenant-caused damage from the fading paint that was already visible in August.
examples.zh: 中介区分了「租客造成的损坏」和八月就看得出来的油漆褪色。

examples.en: The report described the cracked shelf as tenant-caused damage and attached photographs from our checkout.
examples.zh: 报告把裂开的搁板写成「租客造成的损坏」，附上了退租时拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: harm beyond the deterioration expected from ordinary use

examples.en: The landlord called the marks excessive damage, but our check-out report described them as minor.
examples.zh: 房东把这些痕迹称为「超出正常损耗的损坏」，但我们的退租报告记录的是轻微痕迹。

examples.en: We asked what counted as excessive damage before signing the form about the final deduction.
examples.zh: 签署最终扣款表之前，我们先问清哪些情况算「超出正常损耗的损坏」。

words.enDefinition: thorough cleaning that goes beyond everyday tidying and washing

examples.en: My roommates chipped in for deep cleaning because we'd all cooked in the kitchen daily.
examples.zh: 我们每天都在厨房做饭，所以大家凑钱做了一次「深度清洁」。

examples.en: The quote for deep cleaning included the oven, the blinds, and the grout around the shower.
examples.zh: 「深度清洁」报价包括烤箱、百叶窗和淋浴间四周的瓷砖缝。

words.enDefinition: cleaning carried out by a paid service or trained worker

examples.en: We booked professional cleaning for the carpets and kept the invoice in case questions came up.
examples.zh: 我们请人给地毯做了「专业清洁」，并保留账单备查。

examples.en: The agent asked whether we had arranged professional cleaning or intended to clean the room ourselves.
examples.zh: 中介问，我们是安排了「专业清洁」，还是打算自己打扫房间。

words.enDefinition: cleaning done before handing a rented home back

examples.en: We scheduled end-of-tenancy cleaning for the morning after the last roommate moved out of the flat.
examples.zh: 我们安排在最后一位室友搬出后的那个上午做「退租清洁」。

examples.en: My friend shared a checklist for end-of-tenancy cleaning before I picked up supplies from the shop.
examples.zh: 我去商店买清洁用品之前，朋友发给我一份「退租清洁」清单。

words.enDefinition: cleaning by applying hot vapour to a surface

examples.en: The cleaner recommended steam cleaning for the sofa because normal washing had left a mark.
examples.zh: 普通清洗后仍留有痕迹，保洁员建议给沙发做一次「蒸汽清洁」。

examples.en: We asked if steam cleaning was included in the quote for cleaning both bedroom carpets.
examples.zh: 我们问，两间卧室的地毯清洁报价里是否包含「蒸汽清洁」。

words.enDefinition: removing an existing carpet and installing another in its place

examples.en: The agent wanted to charge us for carpet replacement after finding one small stain.
examples.zh: 中介发现一小块污渍，就想向我们收取「更换地毯」的费用。

examples.en: We asked for a quote for carpet replacement rather than relying on the manager's estimate.
examples.zh: 我们要求提供「更换地毯」的报价，以便核对物业经理的估算。

words.enDefinition: painting all of an affected room or area again

examples.en: The landlord proposed a full repaint, although the only mark was next to the doorway.
examples.zh: 房东提出要「整体重刷」，尽管只有门口旁边有一个印记。

examples.en: We received separate estimates for touching up one wall and doing a full repaint.
examples.zh: 我们分别收到了局部补刷一面墙和「整体重刷」的费用估算。

words.enDefinition: paint intended for fixing small marks on an existing finish

examples.en: The caretaker left a tin of touch-up paint for the marks next to our desk.
examples.zh: 管理员留下一罐「补漆用涂料」，用来处理我们书桌旁边的痕迹。

examples.en: I asked the landlord about the paint colour before buying any touch-up paint for the hallway.
examples.zh: 买走廊的「补漆用涂料」之前，我先问了房东墙漆是什么颜色。

words.enDefinition: fill openings in a wall to make the surface whole

examples.en: The manager asked us to patch the holes left by the shelves before we handed over the keys.
examples.zh: 物业经理让我们交钥匙之前「补墙上的孔」，这些孔是拆下搁板后留下的。

examples.en: My roommate offered to patch the holes while I cleaned out the wardrobe in our bedroom.
examples.zh: 我清理卧室衣柜时，室友主动提出帮忙「补墙上的孔」。

collocations: use filler to patch the holes
patch the holes in the wall

words.enDefinition: possessions left behind without plans to collect them

examples.en: The agent asked whether the boxes in the hallway were our abandoned belongings.
examples.zh: 中介问，走廊里的纸箱是不是我们「弃置的个人物品」。

examples.en: We challenged the removal charge because the abandoned belongings were there before our tenancy began.
examples.zh: 我们对清运费提出异议，因为那些「弃置的个人物品」在我们起租前就在那里了。

words.enDefinition: return something to the state it was in before

examples.en: We had two days to restore the original condition before the landlord came back for another inspection.
examples.zh: 房东再次来检查前，我们有两天时间把房子「恢复原状」。

examples.en: The agent said a quick touch-up would restore the original condition after we removed the wall hooks.
examples.zh: 中介说，我们拆掉墙上的挂钩后稍微补点漆，就能让墙「恢复原状」。

collocations: try to restore the original condition
allow time to restore the original condition
work required to restore the original condition

words.enDefinition: the expected level of cleanliness for a particular place

examples.en: The residence sent a cleaning standard that included pictures of a properly cleaned kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍发来一份「清洁标准」，里面有打扫到位的厨房照片。

examples.en: We asked what cleaning standard applied to the fridge before deciding whether to book cleaners.
examples.zh: 决定要不要请保洁前，我们问了冰箱适用什么「清洁标准」。

words.enDefinition: a record of a property's condition at the start of a tenancy

examples.en: We noted the loose window handle in the check-in report and signed the form together.
examples.zh: 我们在「入住交接报告」里注明了窗把手松动，并一起签了字。

examples.en: I used the check-in report to show that the wardrobe door had never closed properly.
examples.zh: 我拿出「入住交接报告」，证明衣柜门从一开始就关不严。

collocations: compare the check-in report with photographs

words.enDefinition: a record of what is found when a tenant leaves

examples.en: The check-out report listed several marks on the wall but didn't include any photos.
examples.zh: 「退租交接报告」列了墙上的几处印记，但没有附照片。

examples.en: I added a note to the check-out report about the key that had already been returned.
examples.zh: 我在「退租交接报告」里加了一条备注，说明那把钥匙已经归还。

collocations: provide comments on the check-out report

words.enDefinition: a final check of a property's condition when tenants leave

examples.en: Our landlord arranged a move-out inspection for noon and asked both roommates to be there.
examples.zh: 房东把「退租检查」约在中午，并请两位室友都到场。

examples.en: I brought the original condition report to the move-out inspection in case there was a dispute.
examples.zh: 我带着最初的房屋状况报告参加了「退租检查」，以备发生争议。

words.enDefinition: an outside professional who records a rental property's condition

examples.en: An independent inventory clerk photographed the front room and checked the listed furniture against the report.
examples.zh: 「独立房屋清点员」给客厅拍了照，并对照报告核对了清单上的家具。

examples.en: The landlord and I agreed that an independent inventory clerk should record the condition at checkout.
examples.zh: 我和房东同意由一位「独立房屋清点员」在退租时记录房况。

collocations: ask an independent inventory clerk to attend
the report from an independent inventory clerk

words.enDefinition: images that show when they were taken or created

examples.en: I sent dated photos showing that the stain was already visible on move-in day.
examples.zh: 我发去了「注明日期的照片」，可以看出入住当天污渍就已存在。

examples.en: The dated photos showed that the missing stool had been removed before we moved in.
examples.zh: 「注明日期的照片」显示，那把找不到的凳子在我们入住前就被搬走了。

words.enDefinition: images showing how something looked on two different occasions

examples.en: We shared before-and-after photos of the kitchen to show that we'd cleaned it properly.
examples.zh: 我们发了厨房的「前后对照照片」，证明已经认真打扫过了。

examples.en: The manager compared our before-and-after photos to make sure the stain didn't spread after cleaning.
examples.zh: 物业经理对比了我们的「前后对照照片」，确认污渍在清洗后并未扩散。

words.enDefinition: a series of documents showing what happened over time

examples.en: I sent a follow-up email after our call to keep a paper trail about the refund.
examples.zh: 电话结束后我又发了封邮件，好让退款沟通有「可追溯的书面记录」。

examples.en: The paper trail made it easy to work out when both roommates had paid their shares.
examples.zh: 有了「可追溯的书面记录」，很容易查到两位室友各自是什么时候交钱的。

words.enDefinition: a collection of documents and other material supporting a case

examples.en: We added the dated photos and two invoices to our evidence pack before sending it.
examples.zh: 发出「证据材料包」之前，我们把注明日期的照片和两张发票放了进去。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my evidence pack and suggested putting the emails in date order.
examples.zh: 住房顾问看了我的「证据材料包」，建议把邮件按日期排序。

words.enDefinition: an amount billed that the person paying challenges

examples.en: The manager put the disputed charge on hold while she checked our dated photos.
examples.zh: 物业经理核对我们带日期的照片期间，暂缓收取这笔「有争议的收费」。

examples.en: We kept a copy of the bill with the disputed charge circled in red.
examples.zh: 我们留了一份账单副本，用红笔圈出了「有争议的收费」。

words.enDefinition: a fee not revealed before an agreement is made

examples.en: I complained about the undisclosed fee because it first appeared after we had moved in.
examples.zh: 这笔「未事先说明的费用」在我们入住后才出现，所以我提出了投诉。

examples.en: The adviser asked when we first found out about the undisclosed fee on our account.
examples.zh: 顾问问，我们最早是什么时候发现账上有这笔「未事先说明的费用」的。

words.enDefinition: a second bill or payment for the same expense

examples.en: I found a duplicate charge for cleaning after comparing the online bill with my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把网上账单和收据一对，发现清洁费被「重复扣费」了。

examples.en: The office corrected the duplicate charge and sent a new copy of the final statement.
examples.zh: 办公室更正了「重复扣费」，重新发来了一份最终账单。

words.enDefinition: an amount billed that is unreasonably large

examples.en: We called it an excessive charge after comparing the invoice with two quotes from local cleaners.
examples.zh: 对照本地两家清洁公司的报价和发票后，我们认为这是「过高收费」。

examples.en: My roommate asked how to challenge an excessive charge without delaying the rest of the refund.
examples.zh: 室友问，怎样对「过高收费」提出异议，又不耽误其余退款。

words.enDefinition: a set total charge regardless of time or other factors

examples.en: The moving service quoted a flat fee rather than charging us for every extra box.
examples.zh: 搬家服务报的是「固定费用」，没有按多出来的箱子逐个收费。

examples.en: The manager said the flat fee was the same for every apartment in our building.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，我们这栋楼每套公寓交的「固定费用」都一样。

words.enDefinition: a charge paid once rather than at regular intervals

examples.en: Is that a one-off fee for issuing the card, or will it appear every term?
examples.zh: 这笔办卡费是「一次性费用」，还是每学期都要交？

examples.en: The residence listed a one-off fee for registering a bicycle in the basement storage area.
examples.zh: 宿舍收费表列出了一笔「一次性费用」，用于登记停在地下存放区的自行车。

collocations: include a one-off fee in the quote

words.enDefinition: an amount that must be paid before something begins

examples.en: The second flat had a lower upfront cost even though both places charged similar rent.
examples.zh: 虽然两套房的租金差不多，但第二套的「前期费用」更低。

examples.en: We asked for the total upfront cost before deciding whether the room fit our budget.
examples.zh: 决定这间房是否符合预算前，我们先问清了总共要交多少「前期费用」。

words.enDefinition: the total expenses associated with taking possession of a home

examples.en: I made a spreadsheet of move-in costs so my roommate and I could compare our options.
examples.zh: 我把「入住前后费用」做成了表格，方便我和室友比较几个选择。

examples.en: The move-in costs included the deposit, the access card, and the charge for booking the lift.
examples.zh: 「入住前后费用」包括押金、门禁卡费用和电梯预约费。

words.enDefinition: a published list of charges for specific services

examples.en: The residence posted its fee schedule near the front desk where students could check it.
examples.zh: 宿舍把「收费项目表」贴在前台旁边，方便学生查看。

examples.en: The key replacement cost in the fee schedule was lower than the one quoted by email.
examples.zh: 「收费项目表」上的补配钥匙费比邮件里的报价低。

words.enDefinition: the highest charge permitted for a particular service

examples.en: The adviser helped me check whether the fee cap applied to this administration charge.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我确认了这笔行政手续费是否适用「收费上限」。

examples.en: I asked which services were covered by the fee cap mentioned in the residence handbook.
examples.zh: 我问了宿舍手册提到的「收费上限」适用于哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: permission not to pay an otherwise applicable charge

examples.en: I requested a fee waiver because the office had issued the wrong access card.
examples.zh: 办公室发错了门禁卡，所以我申请了「费用豁免」。

examples.en: The fee waiver covered the new key but didn't cover the locksmith's weekend visit.
examples.zh: 「费用豁免」免掉了新钥匙的钱，但没有免掉锁匠周末上门的费用。

words.enDefinition: one of several payments making up a total deposit

examples.en: I paid the first deposit installment when I signed and scheduled the second for next month.
examples.zh: 我签约时交了「分期支付的第一笔押金」，把第二笔安排在下个月。

examples.en: The agent sent a reminder about the next deposit installment three days before it was due.
examples.zh: 下一笔「分期支付的押金」到期前三天，中介发来了提醒。

words.enDefinition: the amount one person puts towards a shared deposit

examples.en: I asked for my deposit contribution back after another student moved into my old room.
examples.zh: 另一名学生搬进我原来的房间后，我要求退还我「分摊的押金」。

examples.en: We wrote down each deposit contribution so there would be no confusion when we moved out.
examples.zh: 我们记清每个人「分摊的押金」，免得退租时说不清。

words.enDefinition: security money provided together by two or more renters

examples.en: We paid a joint deposit and asked the agent how it would be split on refund.
examples.zh: 我们「共同缴纳了押金」，并问中介退款时会怎么分。

examples.en: The landlord asked everyone named on the joint deposit to confirm the refund arrangement.
examples.zh: 房东请所有列在「共同缴纳的押金」记录上的租客确认退款安排。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement about who should receive held security money

examples.en: The housing adviser helped us prepare for a deposit dispute about the cost of repainting.
examples.zh: 住房顾问帮我们为重刷费用引发的「押金争议」做了准备。

examples.en: We negotiated directly with the landlord before asking the scheme to handle the deposit dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先直接与房东协商，再请押金保障计划运营方处理这起「押金争议」。

words.enDefinition: ways to settle disagreements without using the ordinary court process

examples.en: The advice centre suggested alternative dispute resolution because neither of us wanted to go to court.
examples.zh: 我们双方都不想打官司，所以咨询中心建议采用「替代性争议解决」。

examples.en: The scheme's website describes alternative dispute resolution and explains how tenants can submit their evidence.
examples.zh: 押金保障计划的网站介绍了「替代性争议解决」，还解释了租客怎样提交证据。

collocations: a form of alternative dispute resolution

words.enDefinition: a person appointed to make a decision in a dispute

examples.en: The adjudicator asked for clear photographs of the flat from the start of our tenancy.
examples.zh: 「争议裁决员」要求提供租期开始时拍摄的清晰公寓照片。

examples.en: I sent the adjudicator a dated copy of the invoice before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止前给「争议裁决员」发了一份注明日期的发票副本。

words.enDefinition: a ruling that the parties involved are required to follow

examples.en: The officer explained that both sides would have to follow the binding decision once it arrived.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释说，一旦作出「有约束力的裁决」，双方都得遵守。

examples.en: We read the binding decision carefully to check how the held money would be divided.
examples.zh: 我们仔细阅读了「有约束力的裁决」，确认暂扣的款项会怎么分配。

words.enDefinition: the latest time allowed for submitting material that supports a case

examples.en: We put the evidence deadline in our shared calendar so neither roommate would miss it.
examples.zh: 我们把「举证截止日期」记在共享日历里，免得有室友错过。

examples.en: The office moved the evidence deadline after granting more time to obtain the repair invoice.
examples.zh: 办公室批准延长索取维修发票的时间，同时推迟了「举证截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: a proposal intended to end a disagreement by agreement

examples.en: The landlord made a settlement offer that returned most of the money to us.
examples.zh: 房东提出了一项「和解提议」，愿意把大部分钱退给我们。

examples.en: I asked my housemates to consider the settlement offer before our call with the adviser.
examples.zh: 和顾问通话之前，我请合租室友考虑一下这份「和解提议」。

words.enDefinition: resolve a dispute by agreement without a court ruling

examples.en: The landlord offered to settle out of court after reviewing the pictures from our moving day.
examples.zh: 房东看过我们搬家当天的照片后，提出「庭外和解」。

examples.en: We decided to settle out of court because both sides were willing to accept a reduced deduction.
examples.zh: 双方都愿意接受较低的扣款额，所以我们决定「庭外和解」。

collocations: agree to settle out of court
offer to settle out of court
prefer to settle out of court

words.enDefinition: a written warning that legal action may follow unless a dispute is resolved

examples.en: The adviser helped me write a letter before action about the amount still owed to us.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我就尚未退还的款项写了一份「诉前告知函」。

examples.en: The landlord responded to our letter before action with a copy of the missing repair invoice.
examples.zh: 房东回复了我们的「诉前告知函」，附上了先前缺失的维修发票副本。

collocations: reply to a letter before action

words.enDefinition: a court that hears disputes involving relatively small amounts

examples.en: I asked the housing adviser how small claims court handles disagreements about deposits after a tenancy.
examples.zh: 我问住房顾问，租期结束后的押金争议在「小额索赔法院」会怎么处理。

examples.en: We kept all the photographs in case the dispute went to small claims court.
examples.zh: 我们留存了全部照片，以防争议要提交「小额索赔法院」。

collocations: file a claim in small claims court
take a dispute to small claims court

words.enDefinition: money paid to submit a case or document to a court

examples.en: We checked the court filing fee before deciding whether to submit a claim for the deposit.
examples.zh: 决定要不要为这笔押金提起诉讼以前，我们先查了「法院立案费」。

examples.en: The adviser explained where to find the current court filing fee on the court website.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了在法院网站的哪里能查到现行「法院立案费」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting where a neutral person helps both parties negotiate

examples.en: We booked a mediation session after disagreeing with the charges for repainting the living room.
examples.zh: 我们不同意客厅重刷的费用，随后预约了一场「调解会议」。

examples.en: My roommate brought both copies of the inventory to the mediation session on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一的「调解会议」上，我室友带来了两份房屋清单。

words.enDefinition: a formal written request for money to be paid

examples.en: We sent a written demand for the remainder after two requests went unanswered.
examples.zh: 两次退款请求都没收到回复后，我们发出了关于余额的「书面催款要求」。

examples.en: The landlord replied to my written demand and agreed that the bank details were correct.
examples.zh: 房东回复了我的「书面催款要求」，确认银行账户信息无误。

words.enDefinition: the New Zealand body that decides residential tenancy disputes

examples.en: A New Zealand housing adviser explained when the Tenancy Tribunal could look at a deposit dispute.
examples.zh: 一位新西兰住房顾问解释了在何种情况下，「新西兰租赁裁决庭」可以处理押金争议。

examples.en: The landlord sent the same condition report to us and to the Tenancy Tribunal.
examples.zh: 房东把同一份房屋状况报告发给了我们，也提交给了「新西兰租赁裁决庭」。

words.enDefinition: pay out the portion that nobody contests

examples.en: Could you release the undisputed amount while we wait for an answer about the carpet cleaning fee?
examples.zh: 我们还在等地毯清洁费的答复，能先「解付无争议款项」吗？

examples.en: The scheme agreed to release the undisputed amount before reviewing our photographs of the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 押金保障计划运营方同意先「解付无争议款项」，再核对我们拍的厨房地板照片。

collocations: request that they release the undisputed amount
agree to release the undisputed amount
authorize the agent to release the undisputed amount

words.enDefinition: accept amounts being subtracted from money to be returned

examples.en: We didn't agree to deductions until we had seen receipts for both of the proposed charges.
examples.zh: 我们看到两笔拟收费的收据后，才「同意扣款」。

examples.en: Please read all the charges before you agree to deductions on the online form.
examples.zh: 请先读完所有收费项目，再在网上的表格里选择「同意扣款」。

collocations: ask tenants to agree to deductions

words.enDefinition: a document showing the balance after all charges and payments

examples.en: Our final account statement showed that the landlord still owed us part of the deposit.
examples.zh: 我们的「最终结算单」显示，房东还应退还一部分押金。

examples.en: I asked for a corrected final account statement because the key fee appeared on it twice.
examples.zh: 补配钥匙费列了两遍，我要求给一份更正后的「最终结算单」。

collocations: request a corrected final account statement

words.enDefinition: undo a billed amount and credit it back

examples.en: Can the office reverse a charge if we return the original key before the weekend?
examples.zh: 如果我们周末前把原来的钥匙还回去，办公室能「撤销这笔收费」吗？

examples.en: I asked how long it takes to reverse a charge after the manager spots a duplicate.
examples.zh: 我问物业经理发现重复收费后，要多久才能「撤销一笔收费」。

collocations: ask the office to reverse a charge
request that the manager reverse a charge

words.enDefinition: a charge for keeping a rental available for someone temporarily

examples.en: The agent in Sydney said our holding fee would go toward rent if we signed.
examples.zh: 悉尼的中介说，如果签约，这笔「房源预留费」会抵作房租。

examples.en: We asked for the terms of the holding fee before paying anything to reserve the flat.
examples.zh: 我们先问清「房源预留费」的条款，再决定要不要付钱留房。
